definitions.gloss: to be intricate; to be complicated; to be complex
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is tangled, intertwined, or complicated in structure. Used for physical layouts (winding streets, coastlines) as well as abstract situations (complicated circumstances, relationships).

examples.japanese: {入|い}り{組|く}んだ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Intricate alleyways continue on and on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{組|く}んで⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}できない→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The circumstances are complicated and can't be explained simply.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海岸線|かいがんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{組|く}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Because the coastline is intricate in this region, there are many harbors.

notes:
Almost always used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form ({入|い}り{組|く}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧) to describe a state of being intricate or complicated. The past participle form {入|い}り{組|く}んだ is also common as a modifier: {入|い}り{組|く}んだ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (a complicated problem).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入|い}り{組|く}んだ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧ — complicated circumstances
- {入|い}り{組|く}んだ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧ — intricate alleyways
- {入|い}り{組|く}んだ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ — a tangled relationship
- {海岸線|かいがんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入|い}り{組|く}む — the coastline is jagged/indented
